blurb: SpiritHorse provides equine-assisted therapeutic riding and learning programs designed to empower individuals through connection with horses. Programs include riding lessons, camps for children and teens, and specialized services for veterans, neuro-diverse youth, and seniors. Activities focus on horsemanship skills, personal growth, and healing in a supportive environment.
